messages:
havish: Quick alert from onboard runs: mercury-v1:int4 shows intermittent removal of ZWJ/U+200D and occasional parenthesis mirroring inside Arabic spans when input mixes zh/ja + ar. Small fraction but BLEU/chrF drop on our subtitle locale suite. Repro: `./evals/run.py --suite locale/mixed_subs_zh_ja_ar --model mercury-v1 --quant int4 --seed 11`

ci-bot: CI: `evals/mercury-int4-multilang/3129990001` ended with regression summary (BLEU -3.6). Artifacts: /ci/artifacts/3129990001/report.tar.gz

tara: Reproed locally. FP16 is clean. int4 failures correlate with: (a) prefix-cache hits, (b) sampling (top_p>=0.7), and (c) inputs with multiple zero-width/codepoint joins.

bo: Paste one minimal failing example and token dump?

havish: Example below (copied from failing case):
```
# src: "\u7d30\u30a4\u306a\u30b9\u30d4\u30fc\u30cb (\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645) \u4e2d\u56fd\u200D\u30b5\u30f3"
# fp16: "\u7d30\u30a4\u306a\u30b9\u30d4\u30fc\u30cb (\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645) \u4e2d\u56fd\u200D\u30b5\u30f3"
# int4 (bad): "\u7d30\u30a4\u306a\u30b9\u30d4\u30fc\u30cb (\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645) \u4e2d\u56fd\u30b5\u30f3"  <-- ZWJ dropped
```
Tokens (int4): [210: "\u7d30", 211:"\u30a4", 512: "\u306a", 999: "\u30b9\u30d4\u30fc\u30cb", 301:" ", 120:"(", 7800:"\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645", 121:")", 2:"\u200D", 701:"\u30b5", 702:"\u30f3"]\nDecoded pre/post: pre-detok preserves U+200D in token stream; post-detok (int4 decode path) returns string with ZWJ removed. fp16 detok keeps it.

sylvie: Interesting. Two immediate suspects: 1) int4 decode kernel's token-to-grapheme stitching drops zero-width when merging cached prefix + new tokens (vectorized remap edge), 2) a post-detok unicode normalization/mirroring pass differs in int4 artifact (different detok lib).

tara: I reran with `--kvcache=false` and with greedy decoding (top_p=0). Both stop reproducing. So the issue needs kvcache+sampling to trigger. Also noticed failures spike when cache boundary ends on a grapheme cluster (ZWJ sits as standalone token).

bo: For mitigation: two short paths: A) per-route decode option `preserve_invisibles: true` to force invisibles to be re-inserted if missing, B) route affected customers to fp16 variant. Which is faster? A is config-only and quick. Example route patch:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: mercury-multilang-protect
    model: mercury-v1:int4
    filters: ["locale:zh-JP","locale:ja-JP","locale:ar-EG"]
    decode_options:
      preserve_invisibles: true
```

havish: I'll draft a PR to add the route flag + a unit test that runs the failing sample under kvcache+sampling. Also uploading a tiny reproducer to internal gist: https://internal.redwood/snap/3129990001/mercury-zwj-repro

sylvie: I'll bisect the int4 kernel changes around kvcache-sampling and the detok roll-forward. Running: `scripts/bisect_kernel.sh --model mercury-v1 --artifact int4 --range kernel-1.4..kernel-1.7` and `tools/bisect_detok.sh --model mercury-v1 --range v2.5..v2.7`.

tara: I'll add temporary monitoring alert to track ZWJ/ZWSP-presence delta across int4 traffic to quantify customer impact. If >0.2% of lines affected we escalate.

bo: If bisect points to kernel numerical threshold in sampling we can push a tiny kernel patch (adjust invisible-token softmin floor) quickly. If it's detok behavior we revert roll-forward.

havish: Customer support note: two pilot customers saw lost joiners in live captions. Offering pin to fp16 or enable `preserve_invisibles` as immediate workaround. Label PR `customer-impact` if we flip routing.

sylvie: Great. Plan: immediate route flag + unit test (today), bisect + kernel/integration fix next sprint. Keeping thread updated. :thumbsup:
